name: herdr-forks
description: Forks of a Claude session open in their own Herdr tab: herdr-fork starts a copy of the current conversation in a new tab of the session's workspace, and a hook sends built-in fork subagents there instead.

layout.title: Fork destination
layout.description: Where /fork opens the fork: right, left, down or up (split the session pane on that side), tab (new tab) or workspace (new workspace).
